key_impacts: More than one million persons displaced
At least five million people affected across multiple countries
Many hospitals and health centres destroyed or damaged
Water supplies disrupted and contaminated; sanitation facilities damaged
evidence_snippets: On 26 December 2004 a 9.0 earthquake west of northern Sumatra triggered a powerful tsunami.
The death toll exceeded 280,000 people, and more than one million persons were displaced.
Good information was available for Banda Aceh; helicopter assessments were conducted along the otherwise inaccessible west coast of Aceh.
missing_information: Specific sub-national locations outside Aceh not detailed in the source

evidence_snippets: 28 March quake affecting Nias and neighbouring islands off Sumatra.
